correctness.rationale: The q-fold root-of-unity sum makes off-residue Fourier Gram entries exactly zero; within each residue N_r the substitution beta=q alpha gives a single symmetric interval Gram. Analytic exterior powers of the Fourier synthesis operator have unique leading Taylor multi-index {0,...,j}, so division of consecutive wedge norms yields eigenvalue c_{r,j} beta^(2j+1). The factor from the monic Legendre polynomial is 2^(2j)/((2j+1)(j!)^2 binom(2j,j)^2 pi), and W_{r,j} is the moment-determinant ratio. Positivity, largest-residue conditioning, and exact collision-free tightness follow. Independent 3-node high-precision Legendre constant checks passed; they cannot replace the all-fixed-mask analytic proof.
